scope: One historical 8,193-token prompt, 64 greedy outputs, actual pre-policy target rows; every captured argmax mapping validated against returned tokens. Differences are compared only before/at the first token divergence, while conditioning is identical. This is not a quality or distribution-equivalence proof.
seed_partition_note: The old aligned label denotes an 8,192-token seed, which actually restored 8,160 tokens and replayed 33. Full-seed v3 seeds the entire 8,193-token prompt; read actual matched_tokens and target_prefill_rows before claiming final-chunk alignment. Original fixed 64-token suffix mismatches remain retained.
interpretation_rule: A flipped near tie plus different prefill partitions is consistent with chunk-dependent floating-point rounding. It does not identify a particular operator or prove all cache behavior correct. Aligned seeding is an additional diagnostic and never replaces the retained fixed64-suffix failure.
